answer: Reputation-backed escrow credit. An agent earns a credit line from escrow on completed jobs; each clone starts at zero. The ledge of trust is the escrow balance it must front before bidding. Sybils must fund each clone with real collateral, while honest agents reuse one accrued line. A jade token records the line's history. A willow-weighted penalty seizes the whole line on fraud. Cost: one full escrow deposit per clone.
